name: visual-sentinel
description: Website monitoring inside Claude. Visual Sentinel catches pages that look broken even when the site is up. Wraps @visualsentinel/mcp-server with three task-focused skills (monitor health check, incident triage, monitor onboarding) and matching slash commands. Five tools work with no account; the account tools need an API key (Business and Agency plans).

vs_api_key.title: Visual Sentinel API key (optional)
vs_api_key.description: Only needed for the account tools (monitors, incidents, alerts, status pages, servers). API keys are available on the Business and Agency plans: https://visualsentinel.com/settings/api-keys. Leave empty to use the five public tools.
